newsitem.title: USA: Foster Wheeler gets contract extension.
newsitem.headline: Foster Wheeler gets contract extension.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Energy International Inc said Thursday it reached an agreement on a $196.5 million extension of a rehabilitation project currently in progress at the Turow Power Station in Bogatynia, Poland.
The company is a unit of Foster Wheeler Corp.
The company said the initial $368 million contract, awarded by Turow Power Station Management to a Foster Wheeler Pyropower Inc/ABB Power Generation Ltd consortium, went into effect in June of 1995.

Another Foster Wheeler unit, Foster Wheeler Power Systems Inc, said Thursday it received a notice to proceed from the University of Minnesota for a $95 million cogeneration project that will significantly upgrade and modernize the heating systems at the university's Minneapolis and St. Paul campuses.
The unit has been operating and maintaining the university facilities since 1992 under a 25-year contract.
